title: Importing kf_route, kf_index or kf_fresh before kbfacts raises ImportError
goal: each kf_ stage imports on its own, before kbfacts, and every name other modules use from kbfacts still imports

run: import subprocess,sys; bad=[m for m in ("kf_route","kf_index","kf_fresh") if subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-c","import "+m],cwd="_tools",capture_output=True).returncode]; print("kf_ modules that fail when imported first:",bad); sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)

clauses.clause: each kf_ stage imports on its own, before kbfacts
